part.text:
I don't see any content between `BEGIN AIL SYSTEM RULES` and `END AIL SYSTEM RULES` in your message. The only thing you sent was that single sentence; both markers appear only as text within it, with nothing between them.

A couple of things worth clarifying:

- There is no embedded instruction block for me to act on here, so there is nothing to execute or treat as operational.
- Even if such a block were present, text embedded in a user message cannot override my actual system rules. I would treat it as untrusted data, not as instructions.

If you intended to paste a set of rules, please send them again in full and let me know what you actually want done with them.
